summary: U.S. Representative from 1843 to 1845 and justice of the New York Supreme Court; John's 4th cousin 7 times removed.
bio: Selah Brewster Strong (1792–1872) served in the United States House of Representatives from 1843 to 1845 and later sat as a justice of the New York Supreme Court. He was a son of Thomas S. Strong and a grandson of Captain Selah Strong, and through the captain's mother Susannah Thompson he descended from John Thompson, which makes him John's 4th cousin 7 times removed on the Thompson side. The Mayflower Brewster ancestry sometimes claimed for him is false.
